title: Axalta Introduces Axalta Irus Scan, a Next-Generation Spectrophotometer, for Refinish Customers
description: Axalta has launched its latest spectrophotometer, Axalta Irus Scan, which provides accurate color matching and reduces waste for refinish customers. The new technology leverages a patented inverse angle and a high-definition RGB camera to deliver productivity, accuracy, and sustainability benefits.

title: NCLA Asks Third Circuit to Eliminate Unlawful DOT Penalty After Landmark Jarkesy Ruling
description: The New Civil Liberties Alliance (NCLA) filed an amicus curiae brief in Axalta Coating Systems v. Department of Transportation, asking the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit to vacate an illegal civil penalty order issued by the Department of Transportation (DOT) against Axalta Coating Systems. The NCLA argues that the DOT's actions violated the Seventh Amendment and Article III of the Constitution.
